# console-chat — an agentic chat panel for the Northwind merchant console

## Problem

Ops staff work the console by clicking through payments, disputes, and payouts. The ask: a chat
window docked on the right-hand side that can answer questions and perform the console's basic
operations in natural language — "show me disputed payments for Brandt & Sohn", "what was
yesterday's captured volume", "give me a CSV of last week's refunds without card numbers".

The chat should "effectively use this session to answer the questions."

## Interpretation (decided; say so if wrong)

A web app cannot literally attach to a Claude Code terminal session. The closest faithful reading,
and the one this plan builds, is: **the chat is backed by the Claude API, on the same model family
as this session, with (a) the repo's own context files as its system prompt** — `merchant-console/
CLAUDE.md` and `.claude/rules/*.md`, so it knows the money/UTC/allowlist conventions the way this
session does — **and (b) tools over the same data layer this session reads** (`src/data/queries.ts`,
`src/data/metrics.ts`, `src/lib/csv.ts`). It knows what the console knows, and it can do what the
console's routes can do.

**Considered and rejected:** the Claude Agent SDK spawning a local `claude` process behind the
route. It would give the chat file-system tools and skills, but it needs the CLI and its credentials
on the server, is not deployable as a plain Next.js app, and hands a web user a shell. If the real
intent is "Claude Code in the browser", that is a different project; file it as a follow-up.

## Current state (verified, with paths — all under `build-battle/merchant-console/`)

- `src/app/layout.tsx:71-83` — the shell is `SidebarProvider > AppSidebar + div.w-full > header + main`.
  There is no right-hand column; the panel needs a flex row here and nowhere else.
- `src/components/Sidebar.tsx` — `"use client"`, context + cookie-persisted open state
  (`sidebar:state`, 7-day cookie, line 19-20). The chat panel mirrors this pattern for its own
  open/closed state rather than inventing a second one.
- `src/components/Drawer.tsx`, `Button.tsx`, `Input.tsx`, `Badge.tsx` — Tremor primitives to reuse.
  No Dialog, Checkbox, or Textarea primitive exists; native controls with Tailwind are the
  precedent (`src/app/payments/export-drawer.tsx`, NWP-101).
- `src/app/api/payments/route.ts`, `src/app/api/payments/export/route.ts` — the only two routes.
  Both read params through `parseFilters` (`src/data/queries.ts:18`). The export route (NWP-101)
  established the repo's error shape: `NextResponse.json({ message }, { status: 400 })`.
- `src/data/queries.ts` — the one query builder: `parseFilters`, `filterPayments`, `sortPayments`,
  `paginate`, `queryPayments`, `paymentById`, `refundsForPayment`, `disputeForPayment`.
- `src/data/metrics.ts` — `dailyVolume`, `headlineMetrics`. **Carries the NWP-102 defects**
  (local-time bucketing at `:25`, refunds over-counted at `:33-34`, mixed currency). Tools may call
  it but must not fix it; that is NWP-102.
- `src/lib/money.ts` `formatMoney` — the only place a decimal point appears. Tools return minor
  units + currency and a display string produced here; nothing else formats.
- `package.json` — no AI/LLM dependency. `vitest` 3, node environment, `src/**/*.test.ts` only —
  `.tsx` cannot be unit-tested, so every decision that matters lives in `.ts`.
- No `.env*` file exists; `.gitignore` already ignores `.env*`.

## Domain rules that bind every card

| Rule | Source | Consequence for the chat |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Validate everything from the client against an allowlist before it reaches a query or the store | `.claude/rules/api-routes.md` | Tool inputs from the model are client input. Every tool validates through `parseFilters` or an explicit allowlist. |
| One query builder | `.claude/rules/api-routes.md` | Tools call `queryPayments`/`filterPayments`; never filter `store.payments` themselves. |
| Money is integer minor units; format once at the edge | `CLAUDE.md`, `money.md` | Tool results carry `amount` (minor units) + `currency` + `amountDisplay` from `formatMoney`. No arithmetic in tools. |
| Never return a full card number; mask everywhere else | `api-routes.md`, `cards.md` | Tool outputs expose `last4` only, as `•••• 4242`. |
| Same error shape everywhere | `api-routes.md` | `{ message }` with an honest status code. |
| Dialogs and forms must be operable; Tailwind only | `components.md` | Panel has an accessible name, the composer has a label, Escape closes, focus returns. |
| Data lives in memory; no DB, ORM, migrations | `CLAUDE.md` | No chat history persistence. Conversation state lives in the client. |

## Architecture

```
ChatPanel (client, right column)  --POST /api/chat {messages, context}-->  route.ts
                                                                              |
                                            system prompt <- prompt.ts (CLAUDE.md + rules)
                                            Claude API   <- client.ts (SDK, server-only key)
                                            tool loop    <- loop.ts (max rounds, tool_use -> tools/)
                                                                              |
                                            tools/  -> queries.ts / metrics.ts / csv.ts (read-only)
                    <-- SSE stream: text deltas, tool_call, tool_result, done, error --
```

- **Streaming contract** (owned by CHAT3, consumed by CHAT4/CHAT5): `text/event-stream` with events
  `text` `{delta}`, `tool_call` `{name, input}`, `tool_result` `{name, summary}`, `done`, `error`
  `{message}`.
- **Request contract** (CHAT3): `{ messages: {role: "user"|"assistant", content: string}[], context?: { pathname: string, search: string } }`.
  Roles and content are allowlisted/bounded server-side; anything else is 400.
- **Tool contract** (CHAT2): each tool exports `{ name, description, input_schema, run(input) }`;
  `tools/index.ts` exports the registry. All read-only.
- **Model**: `claude-sonnet-5` by default, overridable with `CHAT_MODEL`. Key in `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`,
  read server-side only. The implementer loads the `claude-api` skill before touching the SDK.

## Basic operations in scope (read + navigate + export)

| Tool | Backed by | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `list_payments` | `queryPayments(parseFilters(...))` | status/merchant/search/page; returns rows + total |
| `get_payment` | `paymentById`, `refundsForPayment`, `disputeForPayment` | one payment with its refunds and dispute |
| `list_merchants` | `merchants` | id, name, country, timezone, currency |
| `daily_volume` | `dailyVolume(days)` | passes through NWP-102's known defects; says so in its description |
| `export_link` | builds `/api/payments/export?...` | columns/scope/status; the model returns a link, the browser downloads |

**Out of scope, deliberately:** write actions (refund, freeze, issue card). None of those routes
exist in the console today — adding them is a mutation surface with its own ticket and confirmation
UX, not a chat feature. Also out: persisting chat history, rate limiting, auth, multi-turn memory
beyond the client-held transcript.

## Decomposition — five cards, two waves

Sliced for disjoint file footprints first, size second. Repo-root-relative paths.

| Card | Touch-set | Depends on | Model |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CHAT1 panel shell | `src/app/layout.tsx`, `src/components/ui/chat/**` | — | sonnet |
| CHAT2 tools | `src/lib/chat/tools/**` | — | sonnet |
| CHAT3 route + client + prompt | `src/app/api/chat/**`, `src/lib/chat/client.ts`, `src/lib/chat/prompt.ts`, `src/lib/chat/prompt.test.ts`, `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, `.env.example`, `README.md` | — | opus |
| CHAT4 tool loop | `src/app/api/chat/route.ts`, `src/lib/chat/client.ts`, `src/lib/chat/loop.ts`, `src/lib/chat/loop.test.ts` | CHAT2, CHAT3 | opus |
| CHAT5 wire the panel | `src/components/ui/chat/**` | CHAT1, CHAT3 | sonnet |

Wave 1: CHAT1, CHAT2, CHAT3 (pairwise disjoint; 3 of `swarm.maxAgents` 3).
Wave 2: CHAT4, CHAT5 (disjoint: api/lib vs ui).
Critical path: CHAT3 → CHAT4, two waves deep.

## Verification (end to end, after wave 2)

1. `cd build-battle/merchant-console && npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit` — green.
2. With `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` set, `curl -N -X POST localhost:3000/api/chat -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"How many disputed payments does Brandt & Sohn have?"}]}'`
   streams a `tool_call` for `list_payments`, a `tool_result`, then text with the right count
   (cross-check against `/payments?status=disputed&merchantId=<id>`).
3. Same request with `{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"x"}]}` → 400 `{ message }`.
4. Browser: panel toggles from the header, state survives reload, Escape closes it, a question
   about the page you are on ("what am I looking at?") answers using `context.pathname`.
5. Ask for "a CSV of disputed payments without card numbers" → the reply contains an
   `/api/payments/export?...&columns=...&scope=filtered` link with no `last4`.

## Risks

- **Key handling.** A missing key must fail with a clear 503 `{ message }`, never a stack trace or a
  hung stream. Tests run with no key and must not call the network — the client is injectable.
- **Prompt-injection via data.** Merchant names and descriptions are seed data today but are user
  content in principle; tool results are data, and the system prompt says so.
- **NWP-102** is live under `daily_volume`. The tool description states the numbers are known to be
  wrong for non-UTC bucketing and refunds so the model does not present them as reconciled.
- **Vitest cannot test `.tsx`.** CHAT1/CHAT5 acceptance is `tsc` + lint + a rendered-page check;
  the logic they depend on is tested in CHAT2/CHAT3/CHAT4.

## Open questions

- Should `export_link` be able to include `last4` at all? Default no; the model can only add it if
  the user asks explicitly — mirrors NWP-101's default.
- Streaming transport: SSE over `ReadableStream` is the plan; if the implementer finds the Next 15
  route handler buffers, fall back to chunked JSON lines and say so on the card.
